payload.claim: The title's 'a claim of up to twelve sentences' is descriptive color drawn from the observed SA-0327 data (claims ran 6-12 sentences), not the enforced bound; the actual, correctly-specified ceiling is 16 (CRITERION_PROBE_CEILING), matching DESIGN.md section 5.4.1's and CONTEXT.md section 4's already-amended text ('at most sixteen'). No criterion treats 12 as a limit, so this is cosmetic, not a defect.
